item.title: BRA Day: How Tissue Donation Helps with Breast Reconstruction
item.description: One in eight women will be diagnosed with breast cancer in their lifetime. For some, a mastectomy or double mastectomy is part of their recovery. On Wednesday, October 15, 2025, we observe Breast Reconstruction Awareness (BRA) Day in the United States – a time to spread awareness about the options available for women who face breast cancer surgery, and to honor the donor heroes who make so much of that healing possible.
